note: What a client sends to say where its view sits and which way it faces. It is sent once where a server answers it, and again and again where a server does not. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: lookAtX
fields.note: The point the view looks at, along one ground axis: where it stands, plus 2000 units the way it faces.

fields.name: lookAtY
fields.note: Its height, taken the same way.

fields.name: lookAtZ
fields.note: Along the other ground axis, taken the same way.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id the sender holds: that of the client the view belongs to.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: Names this report, counting up as the view moves. A client sends the report again until a server returns the name.
